purpose: Measure progress by decisions, not volume. Appended once a week; commit counts and K-numbers are not progress metrics.

entry_schema.runs: hourly runs in the week, split by lane (B1, B2, B3, C)
entry_schema.matrix_cells_changed: cells whose status moved (open -> constrained -> decided_for_C or empty)
entry_schema.ledger_rows_moved: P-rows or other ledger rows whose verdict changed
entry_schema.kills: bets closed by kill criterion plus matrix cells found empty
entry_schema.reroutes: lanes rerouted by the three-zero-delta rule
entry_schema.tier1_results: count, and how many have a Lean check
entry_schema.summary_for_joe: one screen: what moved, what died, what is next
entry_schema.scope_and_bridge: Evidence-linked decisions by mathematical scope and source bridge; categories may overlap and are not a productivity score.

entries.coverage: Retrospective published scientific runs23->34;11 contiguous manual-accounted increments. No hourly runtime assumed from cadence. Process-only updates uncredited.

tier1_results.scope: Internal horizontal-grade realization/family exclusions; no decided_for_C or source verdict

conditional_structural_exclusions.decision: Held horizontal-grade realization and full metric-normal extension family excluded; effective source bridge absent
Literal section readout fails specified L2/graph domains; modified topology/constrained spaces remain

surviving_controls.decision: Ambient-correlated grade survives; no physical-current/count credit
Mass-gap and scalar cosmology bets remain active with explicit topology/initial-state limits

bridges_corrected_or_unresolved.decision: Source/observed imposter is gamma-trace under actual observation; ambient kernel label alone does not supply the operator or count
Native W175 gap withdrawn; localization promotion premises unproved
Native graded Fredholm observation unresolved; both Nov20 packets retain blocks

scope_and_bridge.counting_note: Decisions, not files; entries overlap. No class-wide percentage or claim that conditional results are zero learning.

entries.summary_for_joe: Eleven scientific runs produced structural constraints, corrections and surviving controls; no source claim, matrix cell or bet was falsified. Two internal T1 exclusions have Lean cores. The source-to-observable bridge remains the principal applicability burden.
